body: Logins CLI facts (v0.3.3, 2026-10-16): `agx profiles` column STATE is the home login state, LOGIN is the login a run spends; --json adds login_name / login_source and keeps login. `aglogin` (shell-init) checks names via hidden `agx login exists`. `login use` on a discovered profile writes every discovered profile of that provider; `login use home -p X` writes `login: home` literally; `rm --force` clears references; `agx plan` accepts only --login home (the profile endpoint refuses setup-tokens); --dry-run never resolves tokens; config.yaml is edited in place by config/edit.go. --cmd needs sh on Windows.
